 Hon'Ble Sameer Jain, J.
1.  Case called out in revised list.
None present either on behalf of applicant or opposite party no.2.
Sri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi, learned AGA for the State is present.

2. The instant bail cancellation application has been filed by the applicant with a prayer to cancel the bail granted to opposite party no.2 vide order dated 07.07.2023 arising out of Case Crime No. 140 of 2023, under Sections 376, 504, 506, 120B IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Modinagar, District Ghaziabad.

3. The instant bail cancellation application is pending since the year 2023 and even today none is present to press the same, therefore, it reflects, either applicant has lost the interest in the matter or by efflux of time, the instant bail cancellation application has become infructuous.
4. In view of above, the instant bail cancellation application stands dismissed.
(Sameer Jain,J.) October 8, 2025 AK Pandey  Dr. Manish vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37698529/
